summary: Discovery of Evelyn's body in the study; scene observed and initial notes taken; evidence recorded: deadbolt slid from inside, sash window latched with pollen on sill, stopped pocket watch at 9:07 with hairline puncture and oil, scrap sealed with red wax found in hand, flake of wax near mantel, three coarse cigarette butts in crystal ashtray, smell of machine oil at the hearth.
A note was made by Aldo indicating that he would perform deductions; photographing and cataloguing assigned to others.

Gathering of witnesses and investigators at the threshold before Aldo enters the study: pair of uniforms, Henry standing restrained, Marta beside the desk, Derek in hall, Inspector Rao at edge with notebook closed.

Physical clues catalogued in scene: deadbolt slid from inside, sash window latched with pollen, stopped pocket watch at 9:07 with puncture and oil, scrap sealed with red wax, flake of wax near mantel, three coarse cigarette butts in crystal ashtray, smell of machine oil at hearth.

Prising up the hearth strip and finding a narrow cavity containing a compact clockwork with oil staining; matching oil to Evelyn's watch; recognitions of a filing nick linked to Derek; inventory and requests made (photograph clockwork, photograph hatch and ladder, access Derek's bench, request ledger). Also interrogations producing contradictory alibis between Henry and Marta and Marta's muttered accusation about money.
Ladder found leaning against boundary wall with a scraped rung; coal-hatch bolt abrasion and coal dust in latch groove observed; noted as measurement-worthy traces.
Clockwork recovered from hearth cavity; oil in mechanism noted, with uncertainty about where oil transfer occurred (mortar, lead hearth, joining timbers) to be resolved later by forensics.
Aluminium ladder observed against boundary wall with scrape; external coal chute bolt abrasion noted; potential external access route recorded; request to photograph hatch and ladder.

Aldo tests the clockwork by winding it; observes it is a single-action cam-and-rod device delivering a short, decisive thrust; times it roughly by feel; notes that the device's delay is compatible with the watch stopping at 9:07; narrows suspicion toward Derek based on skill and access; Rao requests photographs, controlled unwinding, and inspection of Derek's bench.

Aldo tests the clockwork; observes single-action cam and short push-rod travel; times it roughly; ties device timing to 9:07; interprets scrap as timetable (full transcription remains in promise p-001); narrows suspicion toward Derek due to skill and ladder/hatch access; Rao requests photos, measurements, lab unwinding, and inspection of Derek's bench.

Staged demonstration: mock-up run shows push-rod splits plank and can puncture watch; matching wax impression reported from Derek's shed; brass plate's filing nick displayed and recognised; Derek lunges and is restrained; Derek confesses being paid to make an accident and retrieve a page.
